---
name: Bluetooth Alert beta test
about: Report a generated-alert test on one phone and Bluetooth receiver
title: '[Beta test] '
---

Please test while stationary and use generated app alerts. One phone/receiver combination per report. Write **Unknown** or **Not tested** where appropriate; setup failures are useful too.

**This issue is public.** Use generic product models, not personalized Bluetooth names. Do not include notification text, personal details, locations, license plates, VINs, serial numbers, IMEI, MAC/Bluetooth addresses, raw debug logs or old field-test ZIPs. Photos are not needed.

- App version (shown near the top of the app, or on the release page):
- Android phone make/model:
- Android version:
- Receiver type (car / boat / motorcycle or bike / stereo / speaker / headset / other):
- Receiver make/model and year, if known:
- Installation (success / failed / update or signature conflict / not tested):
- Bluetooth music connection (connected / pairing failed / paired but music connection failed / receiver missing / permission blocked / not tested):
- Generated title on receiver (whole title / cut short / wrong characters / delayed / did not appear / still waiting / no display / button disabled / not tested):
- Play (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Pause (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Next (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Previous (worked / no visible effect / button not present / not tested):
- Disconnect/reconnect (test worked again / connected but title missing / could not reconnect / app needed reopening / not tested):
- Music after dismissing alert (automatic resume / manual restart needed / no resume / kept switching / not tested):
- Notification access (left off for generated tests / enabled by choice / blocked or unavailable / unknown):

- [ ] I checked that this report contains no personal information or uniquely identifying device information.

These are my observations on a physical receiver, not a protocol capture or proof of every capability.
